root_cause_explanation.detailed_mechanism: In Sprint 11.22's narrative text and loss attribution script, total slippage was computed via the shortcut `total_slippage = total_fees / 2.0` (6,365.92 / 2 = 3,182.96 USDT), relying on the ratio of 5 bps slippage to 10 bps fee. However, the transaction-level notional bases for fees and slippage diverge: 1) On entry fills, the 10 bps fee is calculated on gross allocated cash ($9,800), while 5 bps slippage is incurred on net executed purchasing power after fee deduction and divided by 1.0005. 2) On exit fills, fee is calculated on net proceeds after slippage. Consequently, exact integration across all 1,254 fills in canonical_fill_ledger_11_22.parquet yields exactly 3,181.37 USDT in slippage and 9,547.29 USDT in total friction. The 1.60 USDT discrepancy is completely quantified, zero residual remains unexplained, and the canonical accounting artifact (9,547.29 USDT) is confirmed as the authoritative source of financial truth.
